look_here_first: Medium-height tufted perennial with a narrow contracted pale panicle whose branches hug the main axis.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays-local source; Kew accepts Tridens albescens as native in Texas.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Installed for active visual learning; exact target-zone county reconciliation deferred.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Poaceae: use growth habit, ligule, panicle architecture, spikelet form, lemma hairs and awns. For this old Tridens complex, panicle openness/color and current genus placement are especially useful.
morphology_keys.comparison_training: The pale narrow contracted panicle is the fastest cue. It is much tighter than purpletop and less open than lovegrass tridens.
